object_description: flat almost square solitaire with volumetric cuts and a large overhang over the entrance
geometry_property: volumetric cuts along the access axis
design_condition: the almost square flat volume sits above the sports areas placed between it and the residential area, with a large staircase and a sequence of terraces linking entrances, fields and garden

positive: The low storey size and almost square floor plan express a precise and comprehensible design idea
The sports areas between building and housing create a mediating outdoor space
The whole complex is accessible along it with a large staircase
A sequence of terraces with different heights is created between the flights of stairs
Entrances, sports fields and planting garden are linked to these terraces
The path continues to a break area in the meadow below the building
The complex is well connected to the neighbourhood beyond the immediate surroundings
The building has striking volumetric cuts along the access axis
These offsets create a joint between volume and terrain
The joint is highlighted on the lowest floor by a slight recess on the structured concrete base
The school rooms are arranged along the facade around the central double sports hall
The importance and presence of the roof in this flat solitaire is recognised and staged
A photovoltaic system completes the glass dress of the wooden structure
Overall a well thought-out and successful project proposal
negative: The formal consistency leads to conflicts in the interior and exterior relationships
No related architectural measures are visible towards the stream side
The connection to the topography appears not to be managed there in a similar way
The main entrance appears relatively small compared to the grand overhang gesture
The building services shaft in the width of the foyer further diminishes it
Where the overhang is two storeys high no appropriate reaction is seen in the plan
The lack of hierarchy of vertical access makes orientation within the floors difficult
Access to the workrooms in the basement is confusing and unattractive
It seems questionable whether the shaded skylights can attractively light the hall three floors below
The economic targets were significantly exceeded
The sustainability goals are not adhered to, though within reach
Whether this typology suits a slope rather than a level situation was not convincingly answered
Whether the design gives the primary school the face it sought remains open
